sentences.text: Archaeomanta belongs to the class Chondrichthyes and the family Mobulidae.
It is considered one of the oldest known relatives of modern manta rays.
The genus was described by Cappetta in 1987.
The genus contains two species: Archaeomanta melenhorsti and Archaeomanta priemi.
This animal lived between 66 and 33.9 million years ago, spanning from the Danian to the Priabonian stages.
Fossils have been found in North Africa, the Middle East, the U.K., the U.S., and Uzbekistan.
